title: Tunisian Galette
description: A French-inspired pastry dessert with a tunisian twist, featuring a flaky crust and a sweet almond filling.
instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Spread the tunisian galette paste over the center of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the slivered almonds over the paste.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the egg over the pastry to give it a golden brown color.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Dust with confectioners sugar before serving.
Optional: sprinkle with granulated sugar before baking.
